evidence: Verified in packages/slides/src/export/pptx/shape.ts: kindToPrst returns the model string verbatim and shapeToXml interpolates it into `<a:prstGeom prst="${kindToPrst(data.kind)}">` with no allowlist or escaping, while the same function escapes el.id. Verified in packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts that assertValidElement checks only id/type/frame and, for shape elements, only data.text — data.kind passes untouched and writeSlidesRoot persists slides verbatim. The chain (PUT hostile kind → stored → PPTX export emits attacker XML) is exactly the sink class the PR hardened for algn/w:jc/srgbClr but missed here. Requires workspace write access and the payload lands in an exported file, so major rather than critical.
